classification.difficultyReason: The completed model and column headings scaffold choosing the quadrant, reference angle and sign before substituting a familiar exact value.

answer.worked:
The terminal ray is in quadrant II, where sine is positive. The reference angle is $180^\circ-150^\circ=30^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}\sin150^\circ&=\sin30^\circ\\&=\frac12\end{aligned}$$

The terminal ray is in quadrant III, where sine is negative. The reference angle is $225^\circ-180^\circ=45^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}\sin225^\circ&=-\sin45^\circ\\&=-\frac1{\sqrt2}\end{aligned}$$

The terminal ray is in quadrant IV, where cosine is positive. The reference angle is $360^\circ-300^\circ=60^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}\cos300^\circ&=\cos60^\circ\\&=\frac12\end{aligned}$$

The terminal ray is in quadrant II, where cosine is negative. The reference angle is $180^\circ-150^\circ=30^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}\cos150^\circ&=-\cos30^\circ\\&=-\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\end{aligned}$$

The terminal ray is in quadrant IV, where cosine is positive. The reference angle is $360^\circ-300^\circ=60^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}\cos300^\circ&=\cos60^\circ\\&=\frac12\end{aligned}$$

The terminal ray is in quadrant IV, where tangent is negative. The reference angle is $360^\circ-300^\circ=60^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}\tan300^\circ&=-\tan60^\circ\\&=-\sqrt3\end{aligned}$$

The terminal ray is in quadrant II, where tangent is negative. The reference angle is $180^\circ-135^\circ=45^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}\tan135^\circ&=-\tan45^\circ\\&=-1\end{aligned}$$

The terminal ray is in quadrant III, where tangent is positive. The reference angle is $240^\circ-180^\circ=60^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}\tan240^\circ&=\tan60^\circ\\&=\sqrt3\end{aligned}$$
